As an instructor, I want students grouped with peers who share similar experiences so that they feel safe being open about their struggles.
As a student, I want to fill out a survey on my challenges and schedule so that I'm matched with people who share them.
As an instructor, I want the system to suggest group matches based on student similarity so that I spend less time manually organizing groups.
As an instructor, I want to have a system to ensure that students can reach out to me with any concerns, issues, or questions.
As an instructor, I want to be able to change around groups at any given moment so that in the event a group doesn’t mesh well I can move them around.
As an instructor, I want my students to see only their own group so that other students' details stay private.
As an instructor, I want to see which students couldn't be placed so that no one is left without a group.
As a student, I want to be able to view others' profiles so that I can get to know them slightly before we meet.
As a student, I want my group to get periodic check-in notifications  prompts so that engagement doesn't fade once the novelty wears off.
As a student, I want to be auto-matched into a group after a short survey so that I don't have to initiate contact myself.
As a student, I want to read a short explanation of how reflection groups work so that I understand what I'm signing up for.
As a student, I want to see research evidence on reflection groups so that I'm convinced they're worth my time.
As a student, I want to search and filter profiles by course and study method so that I can find compatible partners without an instructor.
As a group member, I want a weekly agenda in the group space so that our meetings stay structured.
As a group member, I want to sync group meetings to my calendar so that I don't miss any sessions.
As a student, I want to blacklist specific users so that I'm never placed in a group with them.
As an instructor, I want to launch a reflection group from a pre-made template so that setup takes minutes, not hours.
